independent_read_only_surfaces.focus: native loader environment taint and pre-execution loader redirection
independent_read_only_surfaces.remediation: Treat LD_LIBRARY_PATH and DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH, including whitespace and unresolved values, as startup-environment uncertainty.

independent_read_only_surfaces.focus: Windows junction/reparse traversal, directory bounds, and PathReadContext reuse
independent_read_only_surfaces.remediation: Reject unsafe Windows reparse traversal and enforce bounded path/context handling during filesystem walking.

independent_read_only_surfaces.focus: typed reusable-workflow inputs and composite-action expression/default propagation
independent_read_only_surfaces.remediation: Require reusable input types, preserve true/false/zero scalar values, and return UNKNOWN for unsupported dynamic expressions rather than inventing values.

independent_read_only_surfaces.focus: low-confidence UNKNOWN completion, secret redaction, file URI disclosure, and ScanReport/SARIF completeness
independent_read_only_surfaces.remediation: Keep incomplete or low-confidence analysis from completing, redact composite secrets, suppress file URI leakage, and align report/SARIF completeness metadata.

independent_read_only_surfaces.focus: PEP 517 setuptools build isolation outside the pinned package hash lock
independent_read_only_surfaces.remediation: Keep the package workflow's build tooling under the pinned, hash-checked dependency contract.
